newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia cocoa prices steady, harvest under way.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia cocoa prices steady, harvest under way.

text.p: Indonesian cocoa prices were generally steady on Wednesday from a week ago as mid-crop harvests got off to a slow start, traders said.
They said cocoa was quoted at 2,750 rupiah/kg in Ujung Pandang, capital of the key growing region of South Sulawesi, compared with 2,740 a week ago.
Traders said output from the harvests, which began early this month, had not peaked.
"Arrivals are still small and the mid-crop is expected to yield about 40,000 tonnes," said one trader who recently visited upcountry fields in Ujung Pandang.
